context.position_rule: Provider row order is an indicator sort, never an overall university quality rank; no numeric rank is created
context.precision: Values preserve the precision displayed by the cached official table

identity_basis.join: Exact provider university name -> official CC0 ROR crosswalk -> unique existing ROR; source flag country must equal canonical country; no fuzzy matches

p.label: Core publications · P
p.definition: Number of publications: Number of publications of a university in the period 2020–2023. Collaborative publications are counted fractionally.

p_top_5.label: Publications among the most cited 5% · P(top 5%)
p_top_5.definition: Number of top 5% publications: Number of publications of a university belonging to the top 5% of their field. Publications are counted until the end of 2024.

pp_top_5.label: Share among the most cited 5% · PP(top 5%)
pp_top_5.definition: Proportion of top 5% publications: Proportion of publications of a university belonging to the top 5% of their field. Publications are counted until the end of 2024.

quality_repairs.problem: The cached official headers are P/top-5% scientific impact. The earlier pilot incorrectly named P(top 5%) and PP(top 5%) as international collaboration. Preserve old records for history but hold them from verified public display; correct scientific-impact observations use separate stable metric IDs.
